bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
r=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
b="$HOME/.local/state/gace-userbot-code-rollback-20261113"
u=gace-userbot-verify.service
test -f "$b/userbot_keepalive.py" && test -f "$b/userbot_room_smoke.py" || exit 70
for n in userbot_keepalive.py userbot_resident_ipc.py userbot_room_smoke.py userbot_test_client.py; do test -f "$r/scripts/$n" || exit 71; done
test "$(systemctl --user is-active "$u")" = active || exit 72
before=$(systemctl --user show "$u" -p MainPID --value)
rollback() {
 echo USERBOT_IPC_RECOVERY_FAILED_RESTORING_CODE
 cp -p "$b/userbot_keepalive.py" "$r/scripts/userbot_keepalive.py"
 cp -p "$b/userbot_room_smoke.py" "$r/scripts/userbot_room_smoke.py"
 rm -f "$r/scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py" "$r/scripts/userbot_test_client.py"
 systemctl --user restart "$u" || :
 echo RESTORED_SERVICE=$(systemctl --user is-active "$u" || :)
}
if ! systemctl --user restart "$u"; then rollback; exit 73; fi
pass=0
for i in $(seq 1 24); do
 if test "$(systemctl --user is-active "$u" || :)" = active && test -S "$r/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.sock"; then
  if "$r/deploy/.userbot-venv/bin/python" -B "$r/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" health; then pass=1; break; fi
 fi
 sleep 1
done
if test "$pass" != 1; then rollback; exit 74; fi
after=$(systemctl --user show "$u" -p MainPID --value)
test -n "$after" && test "$after" != 0 && test "$before" != "$after" || { rollback; exit 75; }
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled "$u")" = enabled || exit 76
test "$(stat -c %a "$r/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.sock")" = 600 || exit 77
echo USERBOT_RESIDENT_IPC_RUNTIME_PASS
echo USERBOT_PID_CHANGED=YES
echo USERBOT_AUTHORIZED_NO_NEW_LOGIN=YES
